entries.text: 哈罗德可以告诉你：Richard－理查得、Master－主教、Ghouls－僵尸、Loxley－洛克西里、Cathedral－大教堂、Vault－避难所、War－大战、Decker－德克、Grey－格瑞
entries.source_text: 哈罗德可以告诉你：Richard－理查得、Master－主教、Ghouls－僵尸、Loxley－洛克西里、Cathedral－大教堂、Vault－避难所、War－大战、Decker－德克、Grey－格瑞

entries.text: You see Harold.
entries.source_text: You see Harold.

entries.text: 你看到哈罗德。
entries.source_text: 你看到哈罗德。

entries.text: #Spare change, old friend, old pal?  Can you help a poor mutant down on his luck? 【Cough】
entries.source_text: #Spare change, old friend, old pal?  Can you help a poor mutant down on his luck? 【Cough】

entries.text: 给点零钱花好吗，老朋友，老伙计？帮帮我这个可怜的变种人吧？【咳嗽】
entries.source_text: 给点零钱花好吗，老朋友，老伙计？帮帮我这个可怜的变种人吧？【咳嗽】

entries.text: Yeah, here's $25. Good luck to you.
entries.source_text: Yeah, here's $25. Good luck to you.

entries.text: 好吧，这里是25元。祝你好运。
entries.source_text: 好吧，这里是25元。祝你好运。

entries.text: How about $5.
entries.source_text: How about $5.

entries.text: 5元如何。
entries.source_text: 5元如何。

entries.text: Sorry, don't have any money on me.
entries.source_text: Sorry, don't have any money on me.

entries.text: 抱歉，我没有钱。
entries.source_text: 抱歉，我没有钱。

entries.text: Keep away from me!
entries.source_text: Keep away from me!

entries.text: 离我远点！
entries.source_text: 离我远点！

entries.text: Uhhh?
entries.source_text: Uhhh?

entries.text: 嗯？
entries.source_text: 嗯？

entries.text: #Geez. You're worse off than I am, friend. Luck to you.
entries.source_text: #Geez. You're worse off than I am, friend. Luck to you.

entries.text: 呃。你比我混得还惨，朋友。祝你好运。
entries.source_text: 呃。你比我混得还惨，朋友。祝你好运。

entries.text: #Oh, kind of ya, friend. Very kind. You know, if I could clear the gunk out of there, you, just might find a tear in Old Harold's eye.
entries.source_text: #Oh, kind of ya, friend. Very kind. You know, if I could clear the gunk out of there, you, just might find a tear in Old Harold's eye.

entries.text: 哦，你真好，朋友。你真是好人。你知道的，如果我清理掉这些粘液，你，会看见老哈罗德眼中的泪水。
entries.source_text: 哦，你真好，朋友。你真是好人。你知道的，如果我清理掉这些粘液，你，会看见老哈罗德眼中的泪水。

entries.text: Why is that?
entries.source_text: Why is that?

entries.text: 怎么会这么感动啊？
entries.source_text: 怎么会这么感动啊？

entries.text: You're welcome.
entries.source_text: You're welcome.

entries.text: 不客气。
entries.source_text: 不客气。

entries.text: #【Cough】 Rest of the Hubbers' been picking on me like a bad booger since I came back to town.  I can't leave, though.  When the deals are done 【wheez】 it's still my home.
entries.source_text: #【Cough】 Rest of the Hubbers' been picking on me like a bad booger since I came back to town.  I can't leave, though.  When the deals are done 【wheez】 it's still my home.

entries.text: 【咳嗽】自从我回到这个镇子那些哈勃仔把我像垃圾一样对待。但我不能走。虽然受了不少奚落，【喘气】但这里还是我的家啊。
entries.source_text: 【咳嗽】自从我回到这个镇子那些哈勃仔把我像垃圾一样对待。但我不能走。虽然受了不少奚落，【喘气】但这里还是我的家啊。

entries.text: What happened to you?
entries.source_text: What happened to you?

entries.text: 你怎么了？
entries.source_text: 你怎么了？

entries.text: Who are the Hubbers?
entries.source_text: Who are the Hubbers?

entries.text: 谁是哈勃仔？
entries.source_text: 谁是哈勃仔？

entries.text: Hope things get better. See you around.
entries.source_text: Hope things get better. See you around.

entries.text: 希望事情会变得更好。再见。
entries.source_text: 希望事情会变得更好。再见。

entries.text: #Well, after the Great War, my Vault was one of the first to open. 【Takes a deep breath】 Whew.  Long time.
entries.source_text: #Well, after the Great War, my Vault was one of the first to open. 【Takes a deep breath】 Whew.  Long time.

entries.text: 好吧，核战后，我的避难所是第一个打开的。【深呼吸】是啊，很久了。
entries.source_text: 好吧，核战后，我的避难所是第一个打开的。【深呼吸】是啊，很久了。

entries.text: Tell me more about those days.
entries.source_text: Tell me more about those days.

entries.text: 告诉我那时的事情。
entries.source_text: 告诉我那时的事情。

entries.text: No, no. I meant what happened to change you?
entries.source_text: No, no. I meant what happened to change you?

entries.text: 不，不是。我的意思是什么让你变成这样的？
entries.source_text: 不，不是。我的意思是什么让你变成这样的？

entries.text: #All started with the sirens.  I was young, but ohh, I do remember that.  Lotta terrible years followed.  And I remember walking outta the Vault late one morning.
entries.source_text: #All started with the sirens.  I was young, but ohh, I do remember that.  Lotta terrible years followed.  And I remember walking outta the Vault late one morning.

entries.text: 所有的事情都是随着打开避难所大门的警报声开始的。我那时候还小，但是，虽然遭了这么多年的罪，我仍然记得当时的事情。我记得我是在一个上午走出避难所的。
entries.source_text: 所有的事情都是随着打开避难所大门的警报声开始的。我那时候还小，但是，虽然遭了这么多年的罪，我仍然记得当时的事情。我记得我是在一个上午走出避难所的。

entries.text: What did you do then?
entries.source_text: What did you do then?

entries.text: 然后呢？
entries.source_text: 然后呢？

entries.text: Where was your Vault located?
entries.source_text: Where was your Vault located?

entries.text: 你的避难所在哪？
entries.source_text: 你的避难所在哪？

entries.text: Do you realize how old that makes you?
entries.source_text: Do you realize how old that makes you?

entries.text: 自那以后过了多久了？
entries.source_text: 自那以后过了多久了？

entries.text: #You know, 【cough】 I'm not real sure anymore.  West, I think.  Uh wait - east?  Ooh I don't know.  【Hacking cough】
entries.source_text: #You know, 【cough】 I'm not real sure anymore.  West, I think.  Uh wait - east?  Ooh I don't know.  【Hacking cough】

entries.text: 你知道，【咳嗽】我记不清了。西边，我想。哦等等--东边？哦我不知道了。【干咳】
entries.source_text: 你知道，【咳嗽】我记不清了。西边，我想。哦等等--东边？哦我不知道了。【干咳】

entries.text: What did you do then?
entries.source_text: What did you do then?

entries.text: 然后呢？
entries.source_text: 然后呢？

entries.text: #Well, I was a trader.  Did pretty good making a circuit between survivors.  Lost a lotta good people, though. 【Coughs】
entries.source_text: #Well, I was a trader.  Did pretty good making a circuit between survivors.  Lost a lotta good people, though. 【Coughs】

entries.text: 好吧，我那时是个商人。我们在幸存者之间捣腾货物，干得还不赖。可是，也折了很多兄弟。【咳嗽】
entries.source_text: 好吧，我那时是个商人。我们在幸存者之间捣腾货物，干得还不赖。可是，也折了很多兄弟。【咳嗽】

entries.text: How?
entries.source_text: How?

entries.text: 他们怎么死的？
entries.source_text: 他们怎么死的？

entries.text: #Gangers got'em.  Scavengers attacking the caravans.  And mutants, son of a dog, if they weren't springing up like rabbits with a mission. 【cough】 Had to have an army of guards with, just to do a deal.
entries.source_text: #Gangers got'em.  Scavengers attacking the caravans.  And mutants, son of a dog, if they weren't springing up like rabbits with a mission. 【cough】 Had to have an army of guards with, just to do a deal.

entries.text: 先是被土匪追杀。后来，拾荒者又抢劫商队。最后是那些变种人，狗娘养的，野兔一样蜂拥而来执行任务。【咳嗽】做什么生意都要雇保镖。
entries.source_text: 先是被土匪追杀。后来，拾荒者又抢劫商队。最后是那些变种人，狗娘养的，野兔一样蜂拥而来执行任务。【咳嗽】做什么生意都要雇保镖。

entries.text: Didn't the guards help?
entries.source_text: Didn't the guards help?

entries.text: 保镖有用吗？
entries.source_text: 保镖有用吗？

entries.text: Where were the mutants coming from?
entries.source_text: Where were the mutants coming from?

entries.text: 那些变种人哪里来的？
entries.source_text: 那些变种人哪里来的？

entries.text: #Course they helped, ya bonehead!  Just too damn many to handle!
entries.source_text: #Course they helped, ya bonehead!  Just too damn many to handle!

entries.text: 你够笨啊，当然是有用的了！但是变种人太多了！
entries.source_text: 你够笨啊，当然是有用的了！但是变种人太多了！

entries.text: How did you survive the mutant attacks?
entries.source_text: How did you survive the mutant attacks?

entries.text: 你怎么幸免于难的？
entries.source_text: 你怎么幸免于难的？

entries.text: #Didn't.  Got killed. 【Laughing cough】 Love that joke.
entries.source_text: #Didn't.  Got killed. 【Laughing cough】 Love that joke.

entries.text: 没有啊。我死了啊。【笑着咳嗽】真喜欢这个笑话。
entries.source_text: 没有啊。我死了啊。【笑着咳嗽】真喜欢这个笑话。

entries.text: Uh, yeah.
entries.source_text: Uh, yeah.

entries.text: 哦，是啊。
entries.source_text: 哦，是啊。

entries.text: #Everywhere!  Hell, seemed like you couldn't fart without hitting one.  But mostly in the northwest.
entries.source_text: #Everywhere!  Hell, seemed like you couldn't fart without hitting one.  But mostly in the northwest.

entries.text: 漫山遍野！日啊，你放个屁就会砸到一只。但主要是从西北方来。
entries.source_text: 漫山遍野！日啊，你放个屁就会砸到一只。但主要是从西北方来。

entries.text: Did you explore that area?
entries.source_text: Did you explore that area?

entries.text: 你去过那个地区吗？
entries.source_text: 你去过那个地区吗？

entries.text: Why didn't you just avoid the area?
entries.source_text: Why didn't you just avoid the area?

entries.text: 为什么你们不避开那个地方呢？
entries.source_text: 为什么你们不避开那个地方呢？

entries.text: You farted northwest?
entries.source_text: You farted northwest?

entries.text: 你朝西北放屁？
entries.source_text: 你朝西北放屁？

entries.text: 【Laughs】 Pretty good...Noo...
entries.source_text: 【Laughs】 Pretty good...Noo...

entries.text: 【笑】很好笑……当然不是了……
entries.source_text: 【笑】很好笑……当然不是了……

entries.text: #We mounted an expedition.  God, Richard.  Richard Grey.  Led a small group of us up there.
entries.source_text: #We mounted an expedition.  God, Richard.  Richard Grey.  Led a small group of us up there.

entries.text: 我们组织了一支探险队。对了，想起来了，理查德。理查德·格瑞是我们的领袖。
entries.source_text: 我们组织了一支探险队。对了，想起来了，理查德。理查德·格瑞是我们的领袖。

entries.text: Richard Grey?
entries.source_text: Richard Grey?

entries.text: 理查德·格瑞？
entries.source_text: 理查德·格瑞？

entries.text: Where exactly did you go?
entries.source_text: Where exactly did you go?

entries.text: 你们去哪里？
entries.source_text: 你们去哪里？

entries.text: #Needed to see what was there.  Maybe stop whatever was churnin them boogers out.  We thought we were prepared.  Were we wrong.
entries.source_text: #Needed to see what was there.  Maybe stop whatever was churnin them boogers out.  We thought we were prepared.  Were we wrong.

entries.text: 我们想去看看那里有什么。也许能阻止变种人出来。我们以为自己准备的很周到。我们错了。
entries.source_text: 我们想去看看那里有什么。也许能阻止变种人出来。我们以为自己准备的很周到。我们错了。

entries.text: What did you do?
entries.source_text: What did you do?

entries.text: 你们做了什么？
entries.source_text: 你们做了什么？

entries.text: #I can't remember the route or anything.  But I am damn sure it was northwest, though...I think.
entries.source_text: #I can't remember the route or anything.  But I am damn sure it was northwest, though...I think.

entries.text: 我记不得路了。但我确定在西北……我想是的。
entries.source_text: 我记不得路了。但我确定在西北……我想是的。

entries.text: Is there a shorter version of this story?
entries.source_text: Is there a shorter version of this story?

entries.text: 可以简略的说吗？
entries.source_text: 可以简略的说吗？

entries.text: What about your leader?
entries.source_text: What about your leader?

entries.text: 你的领导怎样？
entries.source_text: 你的领导怎样？

entries.text: #Richard Grey was a doctor.  Little older than me, and friend was he smart.  He found the source.
entries.source_text: #Richard Grey was a doctor.  Little older than me, and friend was he smart.  He found the source.

entries.text: 理查德·格瑞是个医生。比我年纪稍大一点，是个聪明的哥们。他发现了变种人的源头。
entries.source_text: 理查德·格瑞是个医生。比我年纪稍大一点，是个聪明的哥们。他发现了变种人的源头。

entries.text: And what was that?
entries.source_text: And what was that?

entries.text: 是什么？
entries.source_text: 是什么？

entries.text: #I like telling it my way.  Short version will cost you 25 extra, friend.  Which will it be?
entries.source_text: #I like telling it my way.  Short version will cost you 25 extra, friend.  Which will it be?

entries.text: 我喜欢按自己的意思说。简化版需要你多花25个瓶盖，朋友。同意吗？
entries.source_text: 我喜欢按自己的意思说。简化版需要你多花25个瓶盖，朋友。同意吗？

entries.text: Ok, long it is.
entries.source_text: Ok, long it is.

entries.text: 好吧，讲长的。
entries.source_text: 好吧，讲长的。

entries.text: Short.
entries.source_text: Short.

entries.text: 短的。
entries.source_text: 短的。

entries.text: Short, but I don't have the cash.
entries.source_text: Short, but I don't have the cash.

entries.text: 短的，但我没有钱。
entries.source_text: 短的，但我没有钱。

entries.text: How about neither, you old fart?
entries.source_text: How about neither, you old fart?

entries.text: 两个都不要如何，你这个老屁精？
entries.source_text: 两个都不要如何，你这个老屁精？

entries.text: #Well, you seem like an okay sort.  I'll speed it up a bit.
entries.source_text: #Well, you seem like an okay sort.  I'll speed it up a bit.

entries.text: 好吧，看来你这个人还行。我会尽快讲完。
entries.source_text: 好吧，看来你这个人还行。我会尽快讲完。

entries.text: Thanks.
entries.source_text: Thanks.

entries.text: 谢谢。
entries.source_text: 谢谢。

entries.text: Lying to a poor old mutant.  What's the world coming to? 【cough】
entries.source_text: Lying to a poor old mutant.  What's the world coming to? 【cough】

entries.text: 欺骗一个可怜的老变种人。这个世界怎么了？【咳嗽】
entries.source_text: 欺骗一个可怜的老变种人。这个世界怎么了？【咳嗽】

entries.text: Little light on funds, huh?
entries.source_text: Little light on funds, huh?

entries.text: 钱不够，嗯？
entries.source_text: 钱不够，嗯？

entries.text: My way or walk away.  Your choice, friend.
entries.source_text: My way or walk away.  Your choice, friend.

entries.text: 要么按我的说，要么走开。你选吧，朋友。
entries.source_text: 要么按我的说，要么走开。你选吧，朋友。

entries.text: Walking.
entries.source_text: Walking.

entries.text: 我走了。
entries.source_text: 我走了。

entries.text: OK. Long it is.
entries.source_text: OK. Long it is.

entries.text: 好吧。长的。
entries.source_text: 好吧。长的。

entries.text: #Some sort of old military base.  We lost a lotta folks getting in there.
entries.source_text: #Some sort of old military base.  We lost a lotta folks getting in there.

entries.text: 某个老军事基地。进基地的路上我们失去了很多同伴。
entries.source_text: 某个老军事基地。进基地的路上我们失去了很多同伴。

entries.text: How did you know this base was the cause?
entries.source_text: How did you know this base was the cause?

entries.text: 你怎么知道这个基地是源头？
entries.source_text: 你怎么知道这个基地是源头？

entries.text: What were you running up against?
entries.source_text: What were you running up against?

entries.text: 你们碰到了什么？
entries.source_text: 你们碰到了什么？

entries.text: #Robots and such.  Lot of'em.  Damn surprised they was still running after all this time, what with the war and all.  Whooa boy they tore us a good one.
entries.source_text: #Robots and such.  Lot of'em.  Damn surprised they was still running after all this time, what with the war and all.  Whooa boy they tore us a good one.

entries.text: 机器人之类的，很多。该死的，这些玩意这么多年来还能用。我们当时被打惨了。
entries.source_text: 机器人之类的，很多。该死的，这些玩意这么多年来还能用。我们当时被打惨了。

entries.text: What did you do once you got past the robots?
entries.source_text: What did you do once you got past the robots?

entries.text: 摆平了机器人后你们都做了什么？
entries.source_text: 摆平了机器人后你们都做了什么？

entries.text: #Because it was like someone went bargain shopping at mutantland!  Geez!  Cheaper by the dozens!  Can't figure any other reason except that being the factory.
entries.source_text: #Because it was like someone went bargain shopping at mutantland!  Geez!  Cheaper by the dozens!  Can't figure any other reason except that being the factory.

entries.text: 就像在变种人的地盘上赶集似的！啊！变种人太多了！肯定是有工厂在做变种人，没有其他原因了。
entries.source_text: 就像在变种人的地盘上赶集似的！啊！变种人太多了！肯定是有工厂在做变种人，没有其他原因了。

entries.text: Did you examine the base closely?
entries.source_text: Did you examine the base closely?

entries.text: 你进基地仔细调查过吗？
entries.source_text: 你进基地仔细调查过吗？

entries.text: #We got pretty far inside.  Wasn't a lot of us left by then.  Grey, me and couple of others.
entries.source_text: #We got pretty far inside.  Wasn't a lot of us left by then.  Grey, me and couple of others.

entries.text: 我们进的很深。剩下的人不多了。只有格瑞、我和其他几个人了。
entries.source_text: 我们进的很深。剩下的人不多了。只有格瑞、我和其他几个人了。

entries.text: And then?
entries.source_text: And then?

entries.text: 然后呢？
entries.source_text: 然后呢？

entries.text: #One of them robots got Francine.  Mark was wounded, sent him back to the surface.  Then it was just me and Grey.
entries.source_text: #One of them robots got Francine.  Mark was wounded, sent him back to the surface.  Then it was just me and Grey.

entries.text: 机器人打死了弗朗辛。马克受伤了，被送回了地面。然后只剩下了我和格瑞。
entries.source_text: 机器人打死了弗朗辛。马克受伤了，被送回了地面。然后只剩下了我和格瑞。

entries.text: What ever happened to Mark?
entries.source_text: What ever happened to Mark?

entries.text: 马克后来怎样了？
entries.source_text: 马克后来怎样了？

entries.text: What happened then?
entries.source_text: What happened then?

entries.text: 然后呢？
entries.source_text: 然后呢？

entries.text: #To this day, I don't know.  He never made it back here, and...well I...couldn't face the wasteland again, so I...I never looked.
entries.source_text: #To this day, I don't know.  He never made it back here, and...well I...couldn't face the wasteland again, so I...I never looked.

entries.text: 一直没消息，我也不知道。他从没回来，并且……我……也不敢去废土转悠了，因此我……我从没遇见他过。
entries.source_text: 一直没消息，我也不知道。他从没回来，并且……我……也不敢去废土转悠了，因此我……我从没遇见他过。

entries.text: What about you and Grey?
entries.source_text: What about you and Grey?

entries.text: 那你和格瑞呢？
entries.source_text: 那你和格瑞呢？

entries.text: #We made it to some sort of central core, like a plant of some sort.  That's when it happened.
entries.source_text: #We made it to some sort of central core, like a plant of some sort.  That's when it happened.

entries.text: All I got is clothes and freedom, and the latter's debatable.
entries.source_text: All I got is clothes and freedom, and the latter's debatable.

entries.text: 我有衣服被褥，我也很自由，虽然也不算是绝对的自由。

entries.text: Brilliant guy.  A doctor and philosopher.  Long ago he lead the expedition where I got changed into a mutant.
entries.source_text: Brilliant guy.  A doctor and philosopher.  Long ago he lead the expedition where I got changed into a mutant.

entries.text: 聪明的家伙。是个医生和哲学家。很久以前，他领导了一只探险队，我也是那时候变异的。
entries.source_text: 聪明的家伙。是个医生和哲学家。很久以前，他领导了一只探险队，我也是那时候变异的。

entries.text: Who?  Is he some sort of sex therapist?  I could use one, you know.
entries.source_text: Who?  Is he some sort of sex therapist?  I could use one, you know.

entries.text: 谁？他是个老军医吗？我需要他的帮助，你知道的。
entries.source_text: 谁？他是个老军医吗？我需要他的帮助，你知道的。

entries.text: Mutants.  Doesn't matter what they call themselves.
entries.source_text: Mutants.  Doesn't matter what they call themselves.

entries.text: 变种人。不管他们怎么称呼自己，他们就是变种人。
entries.source_text: 变种人。不管他们怎么称呼自己，他们就是变种人。

entries.text: Oh, him.  He leads the Thieves Circle.  Thinks he's Robin Hood. 【cough】 He's alright, I guess.
entries.source_text: Oh, him.  He leads the Thieves Circle.  Thinks he's Robin Hood. 【cough】 He's alright, I guess.

entries.text: 哦，他啊。他领导着盗贼团。自以为罗宾汉。【咳嗽】他这个人还算是条汉子，我觉得。
entries.source_text: 哦，他啊。他领导着盗贼团。自以为罗宾汉。【咳嗽】他这个人还算是条汉子，我觉得。

entries.text: I've seen religions come and religions go, and I hope this one goes.  Soon.
entries.source_text: I've seen religions come and religions go, and I hope this one goes.  Soon.

entries.text: 我看到很多起起落落的教派，我希望这个教派早点滚蛋。尽早。
entries.source_text: 我看到很多起起落落的教派，我希望这个教派早点滚蛋。尽早。

entries.text: Yeah, I came from a Vault.  Too many people, not enough food and water.  But you wouldn't know anything about that, would you?
entries.source_text: Yeah, I came from a Vault.  Too many people, not enough food and water.  But you wouldn't know anything about that, would you?

entries.text: 是的，我来自避难所。有很多人，没有足够的食物和水。但说了你也不会明白的，是吧？
entries.source_text: 是的，我来自避难所。有很多人，没有足够的食物和水。但说了你也不会明白的，是吧？

entries.text: Horrible.  The world just went insane.  Long ago, but I'll never forget it.  Never.
entries.source_text: Horrible.  The world just went insane.  Long ago, but I'll never forget it.  Never.

entries.text: 太可怕了。那时候，整个世界都疯了。很久前的事情了，但是我不会忘记的。绝不会。
entries.source_text: 太可怕了。那时候，整个世界都疯了。很久前的事情了，但是我不会忘记的。绝不会。

entries.text: 【Cough】 Trouble.  Nothing but trouble.
entries.source_text: 【Cough】 Trouble.  Nothing but trouble.

entries.text: 【咳嗽】麻烦的人。只会带来麻烦的人。
entries.source_text: 【咳嗽】麻烦的人。只会带来麻烦的人。

entries.text: Well, like I said...
entries.source_text: Well, like I said...

entries.text: 是的，就像我说的那样……
entries.source_text: 是的，就像我说的那样……

entries.text: Nothing, thanks.
entries.source_text: Nothing, thanks.

entries.text: 没什么，谢谢。
entries.source_text: 没什么，谢谢。

entries.text: Spare change, old friend, old pal? Can you help a poor mutant# down on his luck? 【Cough】
entries.source_text:
